decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app builds directly on the firm's core dental software knowledge, is its flagship line, and fits the digitalisation trend, which the firm's own R&D can keep refining.
The remote screen-sharing tool is embedded in the firm's established support competence, costs little to maintain, and became even more valuable for remote service after 2020.
The performance analytics dashboard draws on the practice data and software know-how the firm already holds, so it can interpret usage feedback and improve the product in-house.
The complete practice bundle mainly packages the firm's existing modules and services, which makes it low-risk and well understood commercially.

The job and practice listing portal lies furthest from the firm's software knowledge base, so it is harder to interpret and improve, but it is cheap to run and reinforces the customer community, so it is kept for now.
